test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

P. the shape of an egg has been highly regarded for its evolution

Q. the body in the most efficient way, not roll away once laid, is structurally

R. as large enough to incubate an embryo, small enough to exit

S. sound enough to bear weight and be the beginning of life for so many species
solution:
The **correct answer** is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here's an explanation of each part:
 
 
• **P -** "The shape of an egg has been highly regarded for its evolution" - This part serves as **a good opening statement** because it introduces the main subject: the shape of an egg.
 
• **R -** "As large enough to incubate an embryo, small enough to exit" - This is **a description that elaborates **on the qualities of the egg's shape mentioned in part P.
 
• **Q -** "The body in the most efficient way, not roll away once laid" - This** continues the description **started in part R, adding more qualities of the egg's shape.
 
• **S -** "Is structurally sound enough to bear weight and be the beginning of life for so many species" - **This concluding part** sums up why the shape of the egg has been highly regarded for its evolution, tying the sentence together neatly.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct sentence arrangement **is: **'PRQS'** i.e. *"The shape of an egg, as large enough to incubate an embryo, small enough to exit the body in the most efficient way, not roll away once laid, has been highly regarded for its evolution, is structurally sound enough to bear weight and be the beginning of life for so many species."*
